content: Fabric 26.2 documents separate common and client entrypoints. Register shared content and CustomPacketPayload types in common initialization; register renderers, HUD, and client receivers only from the client entrypoint. Singleplayer still has a logical server, so gameplay authority belongs server-side and client-originated payloads require server validation. The official 26.2 porting material flags registration and rendering changes, so isolate those APIs behind bootstrap and client adapter classes.
